verdict.rationale: Checkout.com documents processing in 150+ currencies and getting paid in local currencies. It also offers an FX rates API exposing the indicative rates it uses for acquiring, and its reconciliation docs break out an FX rate fee alongside settlement reports, which covers the core of charging locally and handling FX transparently. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of choosing a settlement currency and converting to a home-currency bank account, published FX markup or pricing details (pricing is sales-led), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
